kind.description: What sort of organization it is: a company, a cooperative, a nonprofit, a collective, a project, a public body. Apps show others as unknown.

links.description: Other public pages of the organization (social profiles, wikipedia, etc.).

createdAt.description: When this author first described the organization.

updatedAt.description: When this author last saved this version. The most recently edited version is the one shown, unless the organization publishes its own.

id.description: The organization's identifier at the provider.

url.description: Careers page, when there is no supported provider.

jobBoard.description: Where the organization publishes its jobs.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country (e.g. 'DE'), alongside its name.

description: A company or organization, described by anyone, like a wiki page: each author's record is one version. The record key is the organization's domain, normalised: the website's host name, lowercase, without 'www.' (e.g. 'example.org' for https://www.Example.org/jobs), at most 253 characters (a DNS name). When the author's handle equals that domain, the record is the organization's own.
